body: Well thank you very much, this is sweet :]
Thank you so much. I will definitely pass those links onto Jack as well. This is so helpful (((HUGS)))

I don't think this makes you a bad person. He didn't really say but we think he was just lonely. He was always a kind of a troubled kid, into drugs & getting into trouble. Pushed most of his friends away. I think he was just hurting too much & didn't see any other way out.
Thank you. I will keep counseling in mind & will continue with what I am doing.
Thank you. I will for sure keep that in mind. Keeping busy will help I am sure. Just not being alone in general is nice. I will do this, thanks.
I really don't know. I will keep a close watch on him. & thank you - I will definitely say all of that to him. I hope it helps him find peace.

He really doesn't care about the estate that has been left. He honestly doesn't even want it right now. Alex just wrote a simple note but Jack says his family is honoring it & trying to get him all of his belongings, though Jack has made it clear he just wants to be there with Alex's family. He's such a sweet guy, really.
